children: Our Bureau Mumbai: HDFC Bank has initiated an internal review into allegations of confidential business information being shared with outsiders by two senior executives, following concerns over potential breaches of its code of conduct and governance standards. The bank, in a statement, said that an internal review was underway and said appropriate action would be taken based on its findings. "We take any report of potential violations seriously. In line with our policies, an internal review into this matter is currently underway to gather and evaluate all relevant facts," HDFC Bank said. The lender has not publicly identified the executives or disclosed the nature of the information allegedly shared. "To protect the integrity of the process and the privacy of all parties involved, we do not comment on active internal reviews. Appropriate action will be taken based on the findings, once the review is complete," the bank said. The statement follows a report pulished in Bloomberg that said an internal investigation at the SBI had found evidence that two senior executives disclosed confidential business strategies.

title: HDFC Probes Alleged Data Sharing by 2 Executives
